title: Mixing: Ain’t That A Shame, Slippin’ And Slidin’, Medley: Rip It Up/Ready Teddy by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

John Lennon mixed three recordings for his Rock ‘N’ Roll album on 5 November 1974.

The songs were ‘Ain’t That A Shame’, ‘Slippin’ And Slidin”, and ‘Medley: Rip It Up/Ready Teddy’.

The mixing of ‘Slippin’ And Slidin” proved unusually problematic, and it was remixed again on 6 and 7 November.
